title: PRAY THIS BEFORE SUNRISE AND CANCEL EVERY EVIL APPOINTMENT SET FOR YOUR DAY
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Thank you, Lord. Thank you, Jesus. We worship you. We magnify your name. There is none like you. There is none beside you. >> [music] >> In all the earth, there is none that can be compared unto you. You are the King [music] of kings. You are the Lord of lords. You are the Ancient of Days. The one who was and who is and who is to come. The Almighty. We worship you tonight. We give you praise. We give you honor. Let every breath praise you. Let every heartbeat declare your excellency. Hallelujah. Father, we come into your presence not by our merit, not by our righteousness, but by the blood of the lamb. We come through the door that was opened by the sacrifice of Calvary. We come because you invited us. We come [music] because you said, "Come boldly unto the throne of grace that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need." [music] Hebrews chapter 4 verses 16. So, we come, Lord. We come with expectation. We come with hunger. We come with thirst. And we ask that you would fill this place with your glory. Let the atmosphere shift. Let the heavens open. Let angelic activity increase over this gathering in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. >> [music] >> I want you to do something right now wherever you are. Whether you are watching this on your phone, whether you are listening to this in your car, whether you are in your room preparing for the day, I want you to lift your two hands right now and just begin to worship the Lord. Just begin to thank him. Before we enter into the word, before we enter into the place of prayer, >> [music] >> let your worship go before you. Worship is the master key. Worship opens dimensions that intellect cannot access. Worship brings you into the council chamber of the Almighty. So, worship him. Worship the Lord right now. Thank you, Jesus. Thank you, Lord. We worship you. Blessed be your name. Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God almighty. The whole earth is filled with your glory. We declare your majesty. We declare your sovereignty over this day, over this hour, over every life connected to this broadcast. Let your name be exalted. Let your name be praised. Hallelujah. And I want to encourage you right now. If this ministration is blessing you, share it. Send the link to somebody. Put it in your family group chat. Put it in your WhatsApp status. You do not know who God wants to reach through you. >> [music] >> You might be the bridge between someone and their miracle. You might be the instrument that God uses >> [music] >> to change the trajectory of someone's life tonight. Do not keep this to yourself. [music] There is someone right now who is in the middle of a battle and this word, this prayer is the weapon they need. >> [music] >> So, share it. God will reward you for being a distributor of his grace. Hallelujah. Now, listen to me carefully. The spirit of God began to deal with me about something and I want to share it with you before we go into prayer. There is a mystery that many believers do not understand. And because they do not understand it, they keep losing [music] battles that they should have won long ago. Listen. The Bible says in the book of Ephesians chapter 6 verses 12, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, [music] against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." Now, catch this. The word wrestle [music] in that scripture is a present continuous tense. It means the wrestling is ongoing. It is not something that happened in the past. It is [music] not something that will happen in the future. It is happening right now. While you are sleeping, while you are eating, while you are going about your daily business, there are forces that are actively engaged in warfare against your destiny. And one of the strategies of the enemy, listen to me, one of the primary strategies of the kingdom of darkness is the scheduling [singing and music] of evil appointments. What do I mean by evil appointments? >> [music] >> An evil appointment is a premeditated [singing] spiritual arrangement set in the realm of the spirit to manifest as tragedy, loss, failure, shame, sickness, or death in the life of a person at a specific time. Did you hear that? At a specific time. The enemy does not operate randomly. Darkness is not disorganized. >> [music] >> The Bible says in the book of Psalm 56:5-6, "Every day they wrest my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil. >> [music] >> They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps when they wait for my soul." Did you see that? They gather themselves together. That is a meeting. That is a council. [music] That is a session where evil personalities sit down and discuss your life, your marriage, your finances, your health, your children. They mark your steps, they study your patterns, [music] they study your vulnerabilities, and then they set appointments, they schedule encounters designed to destroy you. There are dimensions to this that I need you to understand. The first dimension is what I call temporal evil appointments. These are appointments that are tied to [music] time. The enemy knows that certain times of the day, certain seasons, certain months, certain years are more vulnerable for certain people. Some families have a pattern. Every 5 years something happens. Every time someone in the family is about to get married, something goes wrong. Every time someone in the family gets a promotion, something collapses. That is not coincidence. That is a temporal evil appointment. >> [music] >> It is a recurring spiritual schedule that was programmed into the bloodline by ancestral covenants. The second dimension is what I call geographical evil appointments. These are appointments tied to locations. [music and singing] You move to a new city and everything falls apart. You relocate to a new country and suddenly your health deteriorates. You visit a certain place and accidents happen. [music] The enemy has stationed territorial spirits at certain locations and when you enter their jurisdiction without spiritual covering, you encounter what was waiting for you there. This is why in Joshua chapter 5, >> [music] >> before Joshua could conquer Jericho, he had to encounter the captain of the Lord's host. Before you can prosper in a new [music] territory, the spiritual atmosphere must be addressed. The third dimension is what I call relational evil appointments. These appointments channel through people. [music] The enemy sends people [singing] into your life not for fellowship but for destruction. Some of those friendships are not from God. Some of those relationships are demonic assignments. The person smiles with you, eats with you, even prays with you, but [music] they carry an agenda from the pit of hell. Judas sat at the same table with Jesus. Judas [music] dipped in the same dish, but Judas was an evil appointment walking in human flesh. This is why the Bible warns us in 1 John chapter 4 verses 1. Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God. The fourth dimension is what I call dream activated [music] appointments. This is extremely dangerous and very common. The enemy programs evil appointments through dreams. [music] You dream that you are eating and the next day your finances collapse. You dream that someone is chasing you and the next day you receive bad news. >> [music] >> You dream that you are back in your village and the next day an ancestral pattern manifest your life. You dream that you are sleeping with a stranger and the next day your marriage begins to crack. >> [music] >> Dreams are not just imagination. Dreams are a realm of spiritual transaction. What happens in your dream can alter your physical reality if it is not cancelled by prayer. >> [music] >> Let me show you something from the book of Job. Job chapter 3 verses 25 and 26. Job said, "For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me and that which I was afraid of is come unto me." "I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet, yet trouble came." Do you see it? Job said trouble [music] came. Trouble did not just happen. Trouble came. It came like a visitor. It came like someone who was sent. It arrived at a specific time at a specific moment. That is an evil appointment. And the reason I'm sharing this with you tonight is because before sunrise, before the day breaks, before the activities of the day begin, there are things that have already been scheduled [music] against your life. While you were sleeping, meetings were held. While you were resting, altars were consulted. While you were at peace, enchantments were being spoken. And if you rise in the morning without prayer, if you step into the day without spiritual covering, you walk directly into the trap that was set for you in the night. This is why the Bible says in Psalm 5 verses 3, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." David understood this mystery. David understood that the morning is the most strategic time in the spiritual calendar. Before the sun rises, before the markets open, [music] before the traffic begins, the first thing that must happen is that you position yourself in the place of prayer and [music] you cancel every evil appointment that has been set for your day. Now, let me go deeper. Turn your attention to the book of Lamentations chapter 3:22 and 23. It says, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." >> [music] >> Every morning God releases new mercy, but you must understand that every morning the enemy also releases new assignments. [music] There is a contest over every new day. The mercy of God says you will live. The agenda of darkness says you will not. >> [music] >> The mercy of God says this day will bring favor. The assignment of the enemy says this day will bring loss, and whoever gets to you first in the morning wins. That is why the enemy loves to attack people in the morning. That is why some of you wake up with heaviness. You went to bed fine, but you woke up and something shifted. You woke up with unexplainable sadness. You woke up with anxiety. You woke up with fear. You woke [music] up with confusion. Some of you have had dreams in the night where you were eating, where you were being pursued, >> [music] >> where you were seeing dead relatives, where you were back in your village, where you were swimming in dirty water. Those are not ordinary dreams. Those are spiritual transactions that took [music] place while your body was asleep and your spirit was vulnerable. And when you wake up, the effects of those transactions begin to manifest in your day. But I have good news for you tonight. The reason God brought you to this broadcast is because this is your moment of reversal. Everything the enemy has scheduled for you, we are about to cancel it. Every evil appointment, [music] every dark arrangement, every satanic programming, every witchcraft agenda, we are about to dismantle it by the power of the Holy Ghost. Hallelujah. Let me give you one more key before we enter into the prayer. Listen carefully. The Bible makes it clear in Colossians chapter 2 verses 14 and 15. It says, "Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross. >> [music] >> And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it." [music] There is a legal system in the spirit realm. There are ordinances, documents, [music] decrees, and records that the enemy uses to enforce [singing] evil appointments. >> [music] >> Some of these documents were written by your ancestors through their involvement in idolatry. Some were written by your own sins and mistakes. Some were written through curses spoken over you by people with evil intent. But the cross of Jesus Christ blotted them out. The blood erased the records. The death and resurrection of Christ stripped the enemy of his legal authority. However, [music] and this is critical, you must enforce it. The legal victory has been won, but the enforcement must happen [music] through your prayers. When you pray, you are presenting the legal verdict of the cross before the courts of heaven and commanding the enemy to comply. And also look at Isaiah chapter 54 verses 17. It says, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper. And every tongue [music] that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. Now, catch the construction of that verse. It does not say no weapon will be formed. Weapons will be formed. Appointments will be scheduled. Traps will be set. Arrows will be fired. The promise is not that the enemy will stop trying. The promise is that none of it will prosper, but you must enforce that promise. You must activate that scripture over your life. You must open your mouth and declare it. [music] Faith without corresponding action is dead. So, tonight, we're are going to be passive. We're are not going to be religious. We are going to arise in the authority of the name of Jesus Christ and we are going to cancel every evil appointment that has been set for your life. >> [music] >> Now, here's what I want you to do. I want you to stand up right now. If you are in your room, stand up. If you are driving, just stay focused on the road but let your spirit be engaged. If you are at home, put [music] everything aside. This is your moment. This is not entertainment. This is not background noise. >> [music] >> This is a prophetic encounter that has the power to change the trajectory of your entire week, your entire month, your entire year. Stand up. Lift your two hands and I want you to begin to pray with me. >> [music] >> Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, I thank you for this moment. I thank you for the privilege of prayer. I thank you that you have given us authority over all the power of the enemy and nothing shall by any means hurt us. Luke chapter 10 verses 19. Lord, tonight we exercise that authority. We stand on the finished work of Calvary. We stand on the blood that was shed. We stand on the resurrection power and we declare that every evil appointment that has been scheduled against our lives is cancelled in the name of Jesus. I speak [music] to every evil altar that has been raised against your life. Whether it is in your father's house, whether it is in your mother's house, whether it is in your village, whether it is in your place of work, >> [music] >> whether it is an altar that was raised by a jealous colleague, whether it is an altar that was raised by a bitter neighbor, >> [music] >> whether it is an altar that was raised by the powers of your foundation, I command that altar to catch fire right now in the name of Jesus. Fire of the Holy Ghost, consume every evil altar. Let the blood of Jesus neutralize every sacrifice that has been offered against your destiny. [music] I decree and declare that altar will never speak again. It is dismantled. It is destroyed. It [music] is burned to ashes in the name of Jesus Christ. I am not done. Listen to me. Every altar has a priest. Behind every evil altar is a personality servicing [music] it. Someone is feeding that altar. Someone is maintaining it. Someone is speaking your name over it. Tonight, I decree confusion upon every priest of darkness assigned against your life. Let the spirit of confusion fall upon them now. Let their incantations backfire. Let their enchantments turn against them. Let the evil they plan for [music] you become their own portion. The Bible says in Psalm 7 verses 15 and 16, >> [music] >> "He made a pit and digged it and is fallen into the ditch which he made." >> [music] >> "His mischief shall return upon his own head and his violent dealings shall come down upon his own [music] pate." Every evil they plan for you returns to sender right now in the name of Jesus. >> [music] >> Every evil appointment for the morning canceled. Every evil appointment for the afternoon canceled. Every evil appointment for the evening canceled. Every evil appointment for the night canceled. You will not walk into any trap. You will not fall into any pit. You will not encounter any ambush. The angel of the Lord goes before you. The angel of the Lord is behind you. >> [music] >> The angel of the Lord is beside you. The angel of the Lord is above you. You are surrounded by divine protection. "No evil shall befall you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling, for he shall give his angels charge over you to keep [music] you in all your ways." Psalm 91 verses 10 through 11. >> [music] >> Now, I want to deal with something very specific. I want to deal with the evil appointments that have been set against your destiny, not just your day, but your destiny. There are powers that are not just fighting your today, they are fighting your tomorrow, they are fighting your future. They are trying to ensure that you never become who God said you would be. >> [music] >> They are trying to ensure that your potential is never realized, that your gifts are never expressed, that your calling is never fulfilled. In the book of Jeremiah chapter 1 verses 5, God said to Jeremiah, "Before I formed thee in the belly, I knew thee, and before thou camest forth out of the womb, I sanctified [music] thee. And I ordained thee a prophet onto the nations." God had a plan for Jeremiah before he was born. >> [music] >> But in that same chapter from verses 17 through 19, God had to tell Jeremiah that he would face fierce opposition, kings, priests, and the people of the land would fight against [music] him. The plan was divine, the opposition was diabolic. This is the pattern. God ordains your destiny, [music] and the enemy organizes opposition against it. So, listen to me. I am not just canceling [music] the evil appointment for today, I am canceling every evil appointment that has been scheduled against your entire destiny. [music] Every demonic agenda to abort your purpose, it is canceled. Every satanic plan to truncate your calling, it is canceled. [music] Every witchcraft arrangement to divert you from your divine path, it is canceled. You will arrive at your destination, you will fulfill your mandate, you will accomplish what God sent you to do on this earth. No devil in hell can stop what the God of heaven has ordained. >> [music] >> I break every covenant of untimely death over your life. Some [music] of you come from bloodlines where people do not live long, where people die young, where people die at the peak of their success. I break that pattern tonight. I decree you shall not die, but live and declare the works of the Lord. Psalm 118:17 The covenant of early death is broken over your life. You will live to see your children's children. You will live to fulfill your purpose. >> [music] >> You will live to finish your assignment. Death is forbidden from coming near you in the name of Jesus Christ. I speak to the spirit of accident. [music] You spirit of road accident. You spirit of domestic accident. You spirit of workplace accident. I bind you in the name of Jesus. >> [music] >> You will not operate in this person's life. You will not operate in this person's family. The blood of Jesus is a shield. The blood of Jesus is a wall of fire. No accident, no catastrophe, [music] no calamity, no disaster is permitted to manifest in your life. I cancel every evil appointment with accident from this moment in the name of Jesus. >> [music] >> I want to pray specifically now for your finances. Come close. This is important. Money answers all things. Ecclesiastes chapter 10:19 Your finances are target of the enemy because when your finances are attacked, everything else is affected. Your health is affected because you cannot afford treatment. Your marriage is affected because of the pressure. Your ministry is affected because you cannot resource the vision. Your mental health is affected because of the stress. The enemy knows that if he can control your financial flow, he can control your life. Someone under the sound of my voice, the Lord is showing me something. There is a financial trap that has been set for you. Something is about to happen that would drain your resources. Something is about to happen that would make you spend money you were not supposed to spend. A sudden bill, a sudden demand, a sudden loss, a sudden emergency designed to empty your account. I cancel that financial appointment right now. Your money is protected, your investments are protected, [music] your business is protected, your salary is protected. The devourer is rebuked over your finances. Malachi [music] chapter 3 verses 11, the Lord says, "I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes and he shall not destroy the [music] fruits of your ground." Every witchcraft attack upon your finances, I decree it backfires now. Every enchantment spoken over your bank account, I neutralize it with the blood of Jesus. Every evil hand that is reaching into your finances to steal, to waste, to mismanage, I cut off that hand by the sword of the spirit. Every spirit of poverty, every spirit of debt, every spirit of financial stagnation, I command you to lose your hold right now. You have no authority over this child of God. The Bible says the Lord takes pleasure in the prosperity of his servant. Psalm 35 verses 27. And what [music] God takes pleasure in, no devil can prevent. Your finances are sealed, your wealth is protected. Unexpected doors of provision are opening for you right now. Money is coming to you from the north, from the south, from the east, from the west. Contracts are being released, opportunities are being unlocked, financial ideas are dropping into your spirit. People who owe you will remember to pay. Debts that have been outstanding will be settled. >> [music] >> Resources that have been withheld will be released. In the name of Jesus Christ. And I speak to every spirit of wastage. Some of you make money but you cannot account for it. Money comes in and money disappears. You earn well, but you have nothing to show for it. That is not natural. That is a spirit of financial wastage. It [music] is a demonic entity assigned to ensure that your money never accumulates, that your savings are always depleted, that your investments never mature. I bind that spirit tonight. >> [music] >> I command it to lose its hold over your financial life. From tonight, you will be a wise steward. You will manage well. You will invest wisely. You will [music] save consistently. And you will see the multiplication of your resources in the name of Jesus. Pray with me right now. Open your mouth. This is not the time to be quiet. When it comes to spiritual warfare, silence is defeat. Your voice is a weapon. Your voice is a sword. >> [music] >> Your voice carries authority. So, open your mouth and begin to declare over your life. Say, "Every [music] evil appointment for my day is canceled. Every trap is dismantled. Every snare is broken. I walk in divine favor. I walk in divine protection. I walk in divine provision. I walk in divine health. Nothing the enemy has planned against me will succeed. I am covered by the blood of Jesus. >> [music] >> I am shielded by the power of the Holy Ghost. We speak in the language of the spirit. The Holy Ghost is praying through us right now. Things that the natural mind cannot articulate, the spirit of God is uttering them on your behalf. Romans chapter 8 verses 26 and 27. Likewise, the spirit also helpeth our infirmities. For we know not what we should pray for as we ought, but the spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered. >> [music] >> The Holy Spirit is interceding for you right now. He's fighting battles on your behalf that you do not even know exist. He's canceling appointments that you cannot even see. He's rearranging situations in your favor. He's moving people. He's opening doors. He's closing mouths. He's confusing the plans of your enemies. Trust the work of the Holy Spirit. He has never lost a battle. [music] He will not lose yours. I speak now to every area of your health. Some of you have been battling sickness. [music] Some of you have been dealing with symptoms that doctors cannot explain. Some of you have been given diagnosis that have shaken you to your core. Listen to me. Sickness is not your portion. Disease is [music] not your inheritance. The Bible says in Exodus chapter 15 verses 26, "I am the Lord that healed thee." And in 1 Peter chapter 2 verses 24, "By his stripes you were healed." Not you will be healed. You were healed. Past tense, it is already done. The healing was accomplished at the cross. You just need to receive it. Every evil appointment with sickness, I cancel it now. Every appointment with the hospital that was scheduled by the enemy, I cancel it now. Every appointment with the surgeon that was arranged by darkness, I cancel it now. [music] I speak life to your body. I speak health to your organs. I speak strength to your bones. I speak vitality to your blood. I speak wholeness to your immune system. I speak [music] perfection to every cell, every tissue, every system in your body. >> [music] >> From the crown of your head to the soles of your feet, I command every infirmity, every sickness, every disease, every pain, every affliction to leave your body right now in the name of Jesus. >> [music] >> Cancer, get out. Diabetes, get out. High blood pressure, get out. Kidney disease, get out. Heart disease, get out. [music] Fibroid, get out. Ulcer, get out. Migraine, get out. Asthma, [music] get out. Arthritis, get out. Whatever name it carries, whatever medical label it bears, I command it out of your body right now. You are healed. You are restored. [music] You are made whole. By the authority of heaven, your body receives divine healing tonight. And I speak to those of you dealing with mental health challenges, depression, [music] anxiety, panic attacks, suicidal thoughts, insomnia, PTSD. Listen to me. The enemy targets [music] the mind because the mind is the gateway to your destiny. If he can control your mind, he can control [music] your life. But the Bible says in 2 Timothy chapter 1 verses 7, "For God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." A sound mind is your covenant right. Every [music] spirit of depression, I command you to lift right now. Every spirit of anxiety, I break your power. Every dark cloud over someone's mind, I scatter it by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Clarity is [music] coming, peace is coming, joy is coming, the heaviness is lifting, >> [music] >> the fog is clearing. You are going to think clearly again. You are going to feel hope again. You are going to laugh again. You are going to dream again. You are going to plan again. Your mind is being renewed right now by [music] the power of the Holy Spirit. Romans chapter 12 verses 2. There is a woman listening to me right [music] now. The Lord is speaking about your womb. You have been trusting God for the fruit of the womb. You have been praying. [music] You have been crying. You have been waiting. People have said hurtful things to you. Family members have mocked you. Some have suggested that maybe it is not God's will, but hear the word of the Lord tonight. He says your season has come. What was closed is opening. [music] What was barren is becoming fruitful. I speak to your womb right now. Womb, receive the blessing of God. Womb, be open by the hand of the Almighty. Every medical report that said it is impossible, I overrule it by the word of the living God. The same God who opened the womb of Sarah when she was 90 years old. The same God who opened the womb of Hannah when she was ridiculed and mocked. The same God who opened the womb of Elizabeth when she was old and well stricken in years. [music] That same God is opening your womb tonight. You will carry your own child. You will nurse your own baby. You will sing songs of testimony. The reproach is being rolled away. The shame is being lifted. Joy cometh in the morning. Psalm 30:5. And for you, this is your morning in the name of Jesus Christ. And there is a man listening to me. The Lord says you have been carrying a burden that you have told nobody about. You have been smiling on the outside but dying on the inside. The [music] pressure of provision has weighed upon you. The pressure of expectation has almost crushed you. The demands on your life have exceeded your capacity. But the Lord says I am your burden bearer. Cast your cares upon me for I care for you. 1 Peter 5:7. >> [music] >> The Lord says tonight that burden is being lifted. Relief is coming. Help is on the way. You are not alone. The God who fed Elijah by the brook Cherith. The God who multiplied the oil for the widow of Zarephath. The God who sent ravens to bring bread and flesh. That God has not forgotten you. Your supply is coming. Your help is coming. Your breakthrough is at the door. Do not give up. Do not surrender. Do not quit. This This not the end of your story. This is the beginning of a new chapter, and this chapter is written by the hand of God himself. >> [music] >> I decree and declare over your marriage tonight, every evil appointment against your marriage, I cancel [music] it. You spirit of divorce, you are bound. You spirit of infidelity, you are bound. You spirit of misunderstanding, you are bound. You spirit of bitterness, you are bound. You spirit of unforgiveness, you are bound. You spirit of cold love, you are bound. Every demonic agent that has been assigned to scatter your home, I command them to be arrested by fire. Your marriage will not fail. [music] Your home will not scatter. Your children will not suffer. Love is being restored. Communication is being healed. Trust is being rebuilt. Intimacy is being renewed. >> [music] >> The fire that used to burn between you and your spouse, it is being rekindled tonight. What the enemy tried to destroy, God is putting back together, and it shall be stronger than before. And for those of you who are trusting God for a spouse, listen to me. Your person is alive. [music] Your person exists. Your person is being prepared, even as you are being prepared. >> [music] >> The delay is not denial. The waiting is not abandonment. God is working behind the scenes. He's aligning timelines. He's arranging encounters. He's setting up divine appointments, not evil appointments, but divine appointments that will lead you to your spouse. I [music] decree that the spirit of delay over your marital destiny is broken tonight. Before this year runs out, there will be a testimony. Someone is about to meet the right one, the one God has chosen. The one who will complement your purpose. The one who will love you with genuine love. In the name of Jesus, I speak [music] to every student under the sound of my voice. You are not going to fail. Your mind will retain what you have studied, your understanding will be sharp, your memory will be excellent. Every evil appointment with failure, with poor [music] results, with disappointment in your academic life, I cancel it tonight. That same grace is upon your life right now. Doors of scholarship will open, doors of admission will open. Doors of opportunity in your academic pursuit will open. You will stand out, you will be distinguished, you will be celebrated. Every evil appointment with disgrace, I cancel it. You will not be put to shame, you will not be embarrassed, you will not be humiliated. >> [music] >> The Bible says in Romans chapter 10 verse 11, "Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed." [music] Proverbs chapter 16 verses 7. Pray with fire right now. Do not let this moment pass you. The anointing is heavy in this place. [music] I can feel the power of God moving. Receive the deliverance. Receive the breakthrough. Receive the favor. Receive the restoration. Receive the prophecy. It is yours. Take it by faith. Take it by force. For the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence and the violent take it by force. Matthew chapter 11 verses 12. >> [music] >> Rababashakindaishalomah. Shabatarinakairumbashalai.
